intro.fr: Un siège au Conseil se mérite. Le règlement est clair.
intro.en: A seat on the Council must be earned. The rules are clear.

dialog.fr: Article 3 : un Zodiaque honore ses contrats et vide la Blacklist. Deux contrats, trois captures.
dialog.en: Article 3: a Zodiac honours contracts and clears the Blacklist. Two contracts, three captures.

dialog.fr: Approuvé à l'unanimité. Bienvenue au Conseil.
dialog.en: Approved unanimously. Welcome to the Council.
